title: 20-Year-Old Brat Has A Severe Meltdown After Parents Tell Her to Move Out
description:
Two parents called the police after their daughter’s boyfriend got into an altercation with the step dad. It all started when the parents wanted to let the girl know that she has to move out, upon hearing that information she got mad and brought her boyfriend back with her. It didn’t start out rough however it eventually got to the point. After the police were called, the daughter and her boyfriend fled the scene in a car even after they were drinking. Police caught up to them and questioned them, the boy gave his side of the story and when the girl have her side, it started of sweet but then she switched up when she heard she was going to jail. 

Disclaimer: 

The videos on Police Watch are intended solely for informative and educational purposes. They are not meant to encourage or promote any illegal activities or unsafe behavior.  Body-worn camera footage has been edited for length and in accordance with YouTube community guidelines while maintaining a journalistic focus. The content is designed to provide insight into law enforcement procedures, police interactions, and public safety awareness. Always respect the law and follow local regulations.
